root.label: CBP bulldozes 150-year-old tree occupied by activists in Arizona

events.label: CBP bulldozes 150-year-old tree occupied by activists in Arizona

slots.name: tree age
slots.sentence: Activists in Arizona say they have occupied a new tree after Customs and Border Protection bulldozed a 150-year-old tree Monday that activists had occupied for more than two months in a bid to block wall construction.
